name: FabricCatalystUpdateFromGit
description: Syncs a Fabric workspace from its connected Git branch, optionally binds semantic models to connections, toggles item schedules on or off, and runs post-sync notebooks (e.g. row-level security setup).
author: TechTacoFriday

inputs.name: azureSubscription
inputs.label: Azure Subscription
inputs.helpMarkDown: Azure service connection with access to the Fabric tenant. Used to obtain tokens for the Fabric and Microsoft Graph APIs.

inputs.name: workspaceName
inputs.label: Workspace Name
inputs.helpMarkDown: Name of the Fabric workspace to update.

inputs.name: fabricGitConnectionName
inputs.label: Fabric Git Connection Name
inputs.helpMarkDown: Name of the Fabric Git connection to use when patching Git credentials. Required when the workspace is connected to Git.

inputs.name: semanticModelsBinding
inputs.label: Semantic Model Bindings
inputs.helpMarkDown: JSON array mapping model names to connection names. Use '*' as a wildcard to bind all remaining models to a connection. Example: [{"modelName":"*","cnnName":"my-connection"}]

inputs.name: schedulesBinding
inputs.label: Schedule Bindings
inputs.helpMarkDown: JSON array turning existing item schedules (git-synced .schedules files) ON or OFF by item name. Use '*' as itemName to apply a status to all remaining schedulable items; add itemType (e.g. 'DataPipeline', 'Notebook') to scope a wildcard to just that item type. At most one untyped wildcard and one wildcard per itemType are allowed. Example: [{"itemType":"DataPipeline","itemName":"*","status":"ON"},{"itemType":"Notebook","itemName":"nb_some-notebook","status":"ON"}]. Typically set per environment (e.g. ON only in prod) rather than at queue time.

inputs.name: postDeploymentFolder
inputs.label: Post-Deployment Folder Name
inputs.helpMarkDown: Name of the workspace folder containing notebooks to run after the sync. All notebooks in the folder are executed in order. Use this for any post-deployment automation — role-level security, data validation, configuration, or similar tasks.

inputs.name: notebookMaxAttempts
inputs.label: Max Polling Attempts
inputs.helpMarkDown: Maximum number of status checks when waiting for a post-deployment notebook to complete. Each attempt waits for the interval returned by the API (typically 5 seconds). Increase this for long-running notebooks or when Spark nodes take extra time to initialise.

inputs.name: enableDiagnostics
inputs.label: Enable Diagnostics
inputs.helpMarkDown: Outputs detailed diagnostic messages to the pipeline log. Use for troubleshooting only.
